source.first_and_last_frame: hero_idle.png frame 0 placed at (19, 32) on a transparent 160x112 canvas
source.description: The knight steps forward and swings the sword twice very fast in an X: first a diagonal slash from high on the left down to low on the right that leaves a bright green poison slash trail, then a diagonal slash from low on the left up to high on the right that leaves a dark crimson slash trail crossing the green one, the green and crimson trails form a big X in front of him and fade, then he steps back to the starting stance.

note: Hero colors snapped to the idle palette; trails flattened to green E6FF8C/6EE83C/2FA830 and red FF1A3C/D01C14/9A120E, which the cosmetic recolor leaves alone. Loose red drops removed. Two seeds were made (9101, 9102); 9101 was adopted.
